 By 
 Nebrask A Hospital A Ssociation News Release 
 on Wednesday, November 18, 2026
 NHA Urges Seniors to Research Medicare Advantage Ahead of Open Enrollment 
 On Oct. 14, the Nebraska Hospital Association (NHA) released the 2026 Medicare Advantage Report ahead of the Medicare open enrollment period, which runs through Dec. 7. The report highlights the challenges Nebraska patients and hospitals are experiencing with Medicare Advantage (MA) plans.
 Reimbursement payments from MA plans are significantly less than those from Traditional Medicare for the same services, and 94% of Nebraska hospitals say the shift to Medicare Advantage has negatively impacted their financial position. However, this year alone the federal government is projected to spend $76 billion more to cover MA enrollees than it would have if these beneficiaries were enrolled in Traditional Medicare.
